name: contractforge-tests
description: Checks the ContractForge generators. 'npm test' compiles every generator in every multichain mode, compares single-network output with tests/golden, and runs the multichain behaviour tests. 'npm run test:swap' and 'npm run test:portable' regenerate the contracts and run the Foundry tests (need Foundry). Run from this folder after 'npm install'.

scripts.test: node compile-generators.mjs && node golden.mjs && node multichain.mjs
scripts.test:swap: node dump-swap-sources.mjs && cd solidity && forge test
scripts.test:portable: node dump-portable-sources.mjs && cd solidity && forge test
